signals.name: Marathon Petroleum
signals.thesis: Marathon Petroleum hit a fresh 52-week high as WTI crude spiked +6% on renewed US-Iran tensions. Refining margins widen when oil moves sharply — MPC is the purest US refining play with top-tier crack spread exposure. Forward PE 11.7x with 1.5% yield. The geopolitical oil premium is unlikely to reverse within our 10-day horizon.
confirmations: Fresh 52W high on 2.4M vol — institutional participation confirmed
WTI +6% to $74.67 on Iran tensions = direct refining margin tailwind
RSI 68 — strong momentum without overbought exhaustion
MACD +4.75 above signal line, accelerating
Forward PE 11.7x — cheapest in the energy peer group
invalidations: WTI reversal below $70 collapses the refining margin thesis
Break below $263 (stop) = failed breakout, exit immediately
Iran de-escalation headlines — monitor overnight
Crack spread compression if gasoline demand disappoints

signals.name: Valero Energy
signals.thesis: Valero cleared its 52-week high with +6.3% on Iran oil spike, mirroring MPC's move. VLO runs the largest US refining capacity and owns the renewable diesel pivot (DGD JV). Two energy names in the top 10 is deliberate when oil jumps 6% in a session — this is the macro thesis of the week. Forward PE 12.9x, 1.8% yield.
confirmations: 52W high breakout with 3.1M volume, well above 20-day average
Iran-driven WTI spike = refining margin expansion for the quarter
EMA20 > EMA50 > EMA200 — pristine uptrend structure
Dividend yield 1.8% + buyback program provides floor
MACD +6.4 above signal — strongest momentum reading in 30 days
invalidations: Same oil reversal risk as MPC — watch WTI below $70
Break below $265 (1.6x ATR stop) = trend failure
Crack spread compression on weakening gasoline demand
2 energy picks = correlated risk — size accordingly

signals.name: Cardinal Health
signals.thesis: Cardinal Health trades within 2.5% of its 52-week high at $243.21. Drug distribution is a non-cyclical cash machine — CAH benefits from GLP-1 distribution volumes (Ozempic/Mounjaro) without bearing pharma R&D risk. Forward PE 19.8x is reasonable for the predictable revenue growth. Healthcare is the defensive offset to our energy-heavy allocation.
confirmations: Price at 97.5% of 52W high — breakout territory
EMA20 ($229) > EMA50 ($218) > EMA200 ($198) — strong trend
GLP-1 distribution volumes growing 30%+ YoY through CAH's network
MACD 8.5 = signal 8.5, flat crossover = momentum holding, not fading
Dividend yield 0.85% + consistent buybacks
invalidations: Pharma distribution margin compression from PBM renegotiation
Break below $225 (2x ATR stop) = 10-day thesis invalidated
Drug pricing regulation headlines could pressure the whole sector
RSI approaching 70 — watch for exhaustion above 72

signals.name: Cloudflare
signals.thesis: Cloudflare is 1% from its all-time high after gaining +1.7% while most of the market sold off. The AI-inference-at-the-edge narrative accelerates as enterprises shift to Cloudflare Workers AI. NET is the cloud infrastructure play that benefits from both cybersecurity spend and AI distribution without the concentration risk of hyperscaler capex. Growth premium justified by 30%+ rev growth.
confirmations: Near ATH ($276.8) on a red-tape market day = relative strength signal
+1.7% vs S&P -0.28% — institutional accumulation visible
EMA20 ($242) well below price — strong momentum cushion
MACD 8.5 crossing above signal 4.8 — fresh bullish acceleration
Workers AI + R2 storage = AI infrastructure without GPU capex exposure
invalidations: Cloud spending deceleration in Q3 guidance would hit all SaaS names
Break below $252 (1.5x ATR from entry) = momentum break
Forward PE 173x — any earnings miss will trigger severe multiple compression
High valuation = high fragility to rate surprise

signals.name: Cheniere Energy
signals.thesis: Cheniere is the US LNG monopoly play. Iran tensions directly threaten Middle Eastern gas supply routes, sending European TTF gas futures higher and benefiting the only large-scale US LNG exporter with long-term contracted volumes. Forward PE 13.4x, 0.87% yield. LNG trades 13% below its 52W high ($300.89) — room to recover.
confirmations: Iran Strait of Hormuz tensions = direct LNG demand catalyst for Europe
+2.3% on the session, confirming energy sector bid
MACD crossing above zero from negative = new uptrend signal
Contracted revenue model = low earnings variance, high visibility
13% below 52W high — upside room without chasing
invalidations: Iran de-escalation removes the geopolitical premium fast
Break below $245 (1.9x ATR) = invalidation
European gas storage above 65% could limit incremental LNG demand
Natural gas price collapse below $2.50/MMBtu domestically

signals.name: AbbVie
signals.thesis: AbbVie is 3.4% below its ATH ($261.64) after the Humira patent cliff was fully absorbed by Skyrizi + Rinvoq growth. Forward PE 15.5x is cheap for a mega-cap pharma with 2.7% dividend yield and visible earnings trajectory. ABBV is the quality defensive anchor in a RISK-ON allocation dominated by energy — it provides portfolio balance against an oil reversal scenario.
confirmations: MACD 10.2 — strongest signal in the healthcare sector today
Skyrizi/Rinvoq grew 50%+ YoY, replacing Humira revenue cliff entirely
EMA20 ($241) > EMA50 ($229) > EMA200 ($217) — clean uptrend
2.7% dividend yield + consistent buyback = institutional magnet
Only 3.4% from ATH — breakout territory with low risk of gap fill
invalidations: Immunology competition from Lilly or Pfizer pipeline catalysts
Break below $241 = stops triggered, exit immediately
Drug pricing executive order surprise (low probability but high impact)
RSI dropping below 60 would indicate momentum loss

signals.name: Incyte Corporation
signals.thesis: Incyte printed a fresh 52-week high at $118.77 today. Jakafi franchise dominance + new launches (Opzelura, Monjuvi) are driving revenue acceleration. Forward PE 12.7x is exceptionally cheap for a mid-cap biotech with multiple approved drugs generating cash. The breakout above the prior resistance zone ($115) is a clean technical trigger.
confirmations: Fresh 52W high at $118.77 — institutional breakout signal
Forward PE 12.7x — cheapest profitable biotech in its peer group
MACD 4.67 > signal 3.74 — bullish momentum confirmed
Jakafi revenue moat: 13 years post-approval, still growing
EMA20 ($110) provides strong support 6% below current price
invalidations: Jakafi generic competition timeline acceleration
Break below $110 (1.6x ATR) = failed breakout
Biotech sector rotation if rates spike on CPI (July 13)
Pipeline failure in Phase 3 trial readout (check calendar)

signals.name: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners
signals.thesis: CCEP is the world's largest Coca-Cola bottler by revenue. Trading 5% below its 52W high ($110.9) with EMA20 > EMA50 > EMA200. Consumer staples provide essential portfolio diversification against the energy-heavy allocation. Forward PE 18.8x, 2.3% yield. The stock gained 10% in 50 days, and the pullback to $105 offers a clean re-entry.
confirmations: EMA20 ($101) > EMA50 ($98) > EMA200 ($95) — textbook uptrend
MACD 2.96 > signal 2.29 — bullish, not extended
2.3% dividend yield in a growth-momentum portfolio = stability anchor
Consumer staples outperform when oil spikes compress discretionary spending
Coca-Cola brand = defensive moat with pricing power
invalidations: EUR/USD weakness (FX headwind on European operations)
Break below $100.50 (1.9x ATR) = trend reversal
Sugar tax escalation in EU markets pressuring margins
Consumer spending downshift visible in Q3 guidance

signals.name: D.R. Horton
signals.thesis: D.R. Horton pulled back -4.6% today, landing near its EMA200 ($149) — a classic mean-reversion setup for the largest US homebuilder. RSI 41.5 = oversold on a short-term basis but the medium-term trend (EMA50 > EMA200) remains intact. Forward PE 12.3x, 1.2% yield. Housing demand remains structurally supported by demographics and underbuilding. This is the contrarian pullback play in the scan.
confirmations: EMA50 ($152) > EMA200 ($149) — medium-term uptrend intact despite daily pullback
RSI 41.5 — entering oversold territory for a large-cap, mean-reversion zone
Forward PE 12.3x — historically cheap for DHI, below 5-year average of 14x
Housing starts remain structurally undersupplied in the US
MACD 1.86 still positive — no trend break yet, just a pullback
invalidations: Break below $140 (1.5x ATR from entry) = trend break, not a pullback
Mortgage rate spike above 7.5% on hot CPI (July 13) would crush housing demand
Homebuilder inventory glut in Sun Belt markets accelerates
MACD turning negative would confirm bearish reversal, not pullback

signals.name: Ferrari N.V.
signals.thesis: Ferrari is the EU diversification pick. RACE.MI pulled back -3.5% today to EUR 327.60, opening a window 27% below its 52W high of EUR 447.5. Forward PE 30.7x reflects the ultra-luxury moat — Ferrari has 100% pricing power with a 3-year order backlog. The EUR zone provides geographic diversification against a US-heavy allocation. This is not a value play; it is a quality franchise at a temporary discount.
confirmations: Order backlog extends to 2028 — revenue visibility unmatched in autos
50-DMA (EUR 302) well below price = medium-term momentum intact
Forward PE 30.7x appears high but RACE trades at 40x+ in normal conditions
EUR/USD at 1.14 = tailwind for US investors buying EUR-denominated assets
1.1% dividend yield + luxury brand moat = quality compounding
invalidations: Luxury spending downturn in China (14% of RACE revenue)
EUR 310 stop = -5% from entry, 1.95x ATR cushion
EU recession fears escalating would compress luxury multiples
China tariff retaliation on European luxury goods
